cover_letter:
Hi Logcomex team!

I was thrilled to come across the Especialista em RevOps opening here in Curitiba. Logcomex's trajectory in trade intelligence is inspiring, and I see a direct match between the role's revenue architecture challenges and my hands-on background.

My strength lies in bridging commercial/product thinking with practical CRM engineering, data governance, and workflow automation. At Wipro (Meta Project), I worked alongside MIS data teams and 150+ frontline professionals to optimize CRM workflows—ranking #1 globally in CRM AI adoption (+150%) and cutting ramp-up time by 50%. In my recent builds, I deployed a self-hosted production CRM (NocoDB on Postgres with a 24/7 WhatsApp AI agent integrated with Google Calendar, cutting stack cost by ~85%), alongside Supabase/PostgreSQL pipelines via REST APIs, webhooks, and n8n, plus strict SSOT data schemas in AI Career OS.

I am based in Curitiba and would love to chat about how I can help scale Logcomex's RevOps integrations, data governance, and funnel visibility!

Best regards,
Kevin Augusto Vieira

form_answers.question: What is your experience with CRM, automation, and API/Webhook integrations?
form_answers.answer: I have 6+ years working with CRM systems (Sendpulse, RD Station, Bitrix24, Meta's proprietary CRMs) and automated pipelines. Technically, I built a self-hosted Kanban CRM using NocoDB on Postgres with a 24/7 WhatsApp AI agent integrated with Google Calendar (~85% cost reduction vs. Kommo + n8n Cloud), Supabase/PostgreSQL integrations via n8n, REST APIs, and webhooks, and a 10-stage Sendpulse funnel generating ~R$ 50k at Munzner.
